scope: Mac single-CPU Direct write-alias index and same-run code-validation comparison. ART configurations share a host binary; selected desktop configuration has CLI/GCD functional coverage. Desktop speed relative to earlier commits is observational; iPhone remains unverified.

independent.scope: Independent runtime ARM64 blocks; no Linux/Android/iPhone integration
independent.measurement: Three warm rounds per engine in separate processes, reversed process order for GCD. Same ARM64 bytes and checked results. Direct includes one-million-instruction slice entries; Unicorn includes register exchange. Memory phases include initialization and result verification, with arithmetic sample mean, sampled peak and latest; lifetime RSS peak is separate.

linux_timer.scope: Native single-CPU LKL with translated ARM64 userspace; selected workload only; iPhone unverified
linux_timer.measurement: Guest clock times 128 pipe round trips per memory case; excludes initial COW materialization. Selected preemption, translation and selected Linux mapping implementation included. Memory means are arithmetic sample means, including phase boundaries; sampled peaks can miss short peaks. Resident lifetime peak is separate.
